pages.text:
The meaning of Legacy

[Wikipedia]

• „Legacy code is source code that relates to a nolonger supported or manufactured operating system or other computer technology“

• “Old application programs are considered “legacy” which continue to be used because the user does not want to replace or redesign them.”

• “Legacy software often differs from its suggested alternative by actually working and scaling, making the term not pejorative at all.”

„Forgotten Lore“: CP/M, BeOS etc.

„Never change working code“ – we don‘t why it works…

„It does the job“

FOSS GIS Legacy

Several FOSS GIS projects have been in existence for a very long time, giving them “legacy”:

– UMN Mapserver

– GRASS GIS,

– both are community-controlled projects.

GRASS User Map
